option.value: apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1 kind: PrometheusRule metadata: name: microservices-alerts namespace: monitoring labels: { release: kps } spec: groups: - name: microservices.rules rules: - alert: ServiceHighErrorRate expr: | sum by (service) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="microservices",status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (service) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="microservices"}[5m])) > 0.05 for: 5m labels: { severity: critical } annotations: summary: "{{ $labels.service }} 5xx ratio above 5%" - alert: ServiceHighLatencyP95 expr: | histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service, le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="microservices",route!="/metrics"}[5m]))) > 1 for: 10m labels: { severity: warning } annotations: summary: "{{ $labels.service }} p95 latency above 1s" - alert: ApplicationTargetDown expr: up{namespace="microservices",pod=~"auth-service.*|payment-service.*|frontend.*"} == 0 for: 2m labels: { severity: critical } annotations: summary: "Metrics target {{ $labels.pod }} is down" - alert: NginxExporterCannotReachNginx expr: nginx_up{namespace="microservices"} == 0 for: 2m labels: { severity: critical } annotations: summary: "nginx in {{ $labels.pod }} is not responding" - alert: DeploymentReplicasUnavailable expr: kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable{namespace="microservices"} > 0 for: 5m labels: { severity: warning } annotations: summary: "Deployment {{ $labels.deployment }} has unavailable replicas"
